strategy.summary: Reproduce the f8 layout-conversion MLIR error in Mosaic GPU: build jaxlib with Mosaic GPU support on an sm_100 (Blackwell, TCGEN05) GPU, run the added test_fp8_relayout on the buggy commit 32ea97614e82 (expected to raise an MLIR error during lowering) and on the fixed commit (expected to pass the exact equality check). The transition, not any printed value, is the success signal.

system_packages: clang or the toolchain required by the jaxlib build (not stated)
build_commands: git checkout 32ea97614e82 (buggy revision) and build jaxlib from source with Mosaic GPU enabled per the repository build docs (python build/build.py --enable_cuda or the equivalent for the era; exact flags not stated in evidence)
run the test on the buggy build, then checkout the fix commit (PR 34680 head) and rebuild jaxlib before rerunning
pinned_because: jax version: null, no documented constraint; unbounded, so the strategy chooses to build both jax and jaxlib from the same source checkout rather than pinning a release, and states this choice
jaxlib version: null, no documented constraint; built from the same checkout as jax because the bug lives in jaxlib/mosaic/gpu/passes.cc and custom_call.cc, which must match the Python side

The test depends on TCGEN05_TMEM_NATIVE layouts, which exist only on Blackwell-class (sm_100) GPUs; this is an architecture requirement inferred from the layout name and not a documented version constraint

strategy.reproducing_test: tests/pallas/mosaic_gpu_test.py::MosaicGpuTest::test_fp8_relayout (parameterized over from_narrow False and True; shape (128, 32), dtype jnp.float8_e4m3fn, TCGEN05_TMEM_NATIVE layouts 4 and 8, optimized=False on plgpu.load, skip_if_wg_semantics guard, exact np.testing.assert_array_equal against input)
strategy.success_criterion: On the buggy revision 32ea97614e82, test_fp8_relayout fails (both parameterizations) with an MLIR error raised during lowering, because unrealized conversion casts on f8 vectors do not cancel. On the fixed revision, both parameterizations complete lowering and the kernel output exactly equals the input, so the test passes.
strategy.numerical_probe: Not required for the transition; the test asserts exact equality of kernel(x) with x, so any mismatch would also fail, but the decisive signal is the MLIR exception on buggy versus clean execution.
risks: Requires a Blackwell (sm_100) GPU for TCGEN05_TMEM_NATIVE layouts; on Hopper or CPU the test will skip or fail for unrelated reasons, so the transition cannot be demonstrated there.
Requires a Mosaic GPU-enabled jaxlib build from source; a prebuilt wheel without Mosaic GPU will not reproduce the behaviour.
skip_if_wg_semantics guard: if the environment enables warpgroup semantics the test is skipped rather than failing, which would hide the transition.
optimized=False is specified; behaviour with optimization enabled is not stated by the evidence and should not be assumed.
Exact dependency versions (CUDA, bazel, clang, Python) are not stated; they are null in the evidence and must be chosen from the repo's build docs at the time of the commit.

The buggy-vs-fixed transition depends on the pass order change in custom_call.cc (reconcile-unrealized-casts moved after mosaic-convert-gpu-to-llvm); a build that does not include both the passes.cc and custom_call.cc changes will not show the transition.
The PR date is missing, so the exact era of the checkout is unknown; the commit hash is used to select the revision instead.
No tolerance is stated; the test uses exact equality, so the oracle is exact.

oracle.reference_source: the test input x itself (np.testing.assert_array_equal(kernel(x), x))
oracle.why: The test checks a pure layout round trip of float8_e4m3fn values, which must be bit-identical to the input; no tolerance is stated or needed.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: On the buggy revision the lowering raises an MLIR error about unrealized conversion casts on f8 vectors that were not cancelled, because f8 types are not representable in LLVM IR and reconcile-unrealized-casts runs too early. The exception is raised before any output is compared, so the test errors out and fails.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: On the fixed revision the ExtractStridedSlice pattern bitcasts f8 vectors to integer vectors, ConvertGpuToLLVMPass marks UnrealizedConversionCastOp legal, and reconcile-unrealized-casts runs after mosaic-convert-gpu-to-llvm, so lowering completes and the output equals the input exactly, so the test passes.
